revision: Kusanagi and Muramasa v3 straight katana blades, 2026-10-30

validation.gameplay_scope: This revision changes weapon artwork only. Item scripts, stats and pose metadata are unchanged.

historical_sources: Unversioned and v2 kusanagi/muramasa PNGs and prompts are retained as historical reference only; the selected manifest uses v3.
runtime_changes: Both blades are now almost straight katana blades with a short angled kissaki, replacing v2's bowed silhouettes; grips, guards, colours and ornament are unchanged. Kusanagi is 58 visible pixels long with about 4-5 pixels of main blade face; Muramasa is 61 pixels long with about 4 pixels of face. Attack edge orientation and hand-axis poses are unchanged. Body art and item gameplay are unchanged.
